rationale: SvgPathWidget::set_path skips an unchanged string and repaints the union of the old and new painted extents instead of the whole surface; a redrawn CanvasWidget repaints its own (already clipped) box. Pixel-identical by construction (paint is clipped to those extents), covered by test_widget_bounded_repaint.cpp with confirmed negative controls. No API removed and no authority boundary moves; Pulp-only repaint-scope behaviour.
